src: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Short-Term Energy Outlook, 2026-10 edition (modeling completed 2026-10-01), public data workbook https://www.eia.gov/outlooks/steo/xls/STEO_m.xlsx (1098385 bytes), Table 1 U.S. Energy Markets Summary (sheet 1tab): WTIPUUS WTI spot price, NGHHUUS Henry Hub spot price, COPRPUS U.S. crude oil production, NGPRPUS U.S. dry natural gas production. Months through 2026-09 are STEO history (the workbook's Last Historical Month; survey-based production data lag about two months, so the newest usCrude and usGas history months are typically EIA estimates), 2026-10 onward are forecasts.
